claims.claim: Finite-time compact-mean observation is bounded by C(1+T)^(1/4) times unweighted free phase energy.
The actual cubic Duhamel component has integrated compact trace at most C_S epsilon through time S epsilon^-2; the whole trace is not bounded by this statement.
An even zero-data comparison family with O(epsilon) energy and O(epsilon^3) forcing has order-epsilon trace integral; an O(epsilon^2) bound does not follow from those norms alone.
Actual source-specific threshold cancellation, localized-history control and three-channel action-work transfer remain unpaid.
